title: When every line is declined, Close Work Order is not offered
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Make sure Require Review Before Completion is off in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Estimate, whose only line is declined.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the work order's three-dots menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The header shows no "Close Work Order".

Step 2:

  • The menu does not offer "Close Work Order".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11760 (Story 3, Close an internal or no-charge work order)

  • S3-N2: “If Create invoice would not be offered (review on and not yet marked, or every line declined), Close Work Order is not offered either. With review off and open lines, Close Work Order sits in the three-dots menu exactly as Create invoice does today; once every line is Complete it is the header button and leaves the menu, as Create invoice does.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Internal Work Orders · All flows v6" (https://claude.ai/artifact/5jHR3nLeDinzks1viREFuo), version 1794484794-2031, read and rendered 12 Nov 2026: boards "3c Menu · internal" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "04b Work order · Ready for review" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "05 Work order · Complete, ready to close" (page "Flow 1 · Create and close"), "16 Complete, ready to close" (page "Happy flow v6"). Compare the screen with the pictures; the expected results come from the PRD.
